name_reason: Address 0x53A8D is the base of the shared 28-byte union REGS reused by every int386() INT 10h/16h call (video-mode set AND keyboard read), not a standalone scancode byte. The current Ghidra label models only byte 0 (AL/ASCII) and undersells the slot's role + data type. The actual emitted/linked symbol in the rebuilt src is 'union REGS data_fd2_input_int16_regs' (globals.h:549); 'data_fd2_input_last_key_pressed' is only a preprocessor macro alias for .h.al (globals.h:550) and emits no symbol. Per the Ghidra<->emitted-symbol naming rule the base-address label should be data_fd2_input_int16_regs (reflects the union-REGS data type and multi-purpose role); the AL/AH byte aliases stay as macros. Evidence: get_xrefs_to shows WRITE sites both setting *(uint16*)&...=0x13/3 for INT 10h set-video-mode (main.c:113/175, rsrc.c:354/445) and AH=0x10 for INT 16h read-key (input.c:124 etc.); 0x53A8E carries the partner alias data_fd2_input_key_input_mode (AH). NOTE: rename only recorded; Stage 2 applies it (touches globals.h union decl + macro aliases).
purpose: Base (byte 0 = AL / ASCII) of the shared 28-byte union REGS scratch that every int386() INT 10h/16h call reuses; for INT 16h read-key it receives the ASCII code of the last key, for INT 10h it is the low byte of the AX video-mode argument.
logic_summary: One process-wide union REGS at 0x53A8D handed (by address, cast to union REGS*) as both in/out reg blocks to int386(). INT 16h fn 0x10 path: callers preset AH(0x53A8E)=0x10, call int386(0x16, &regs, &regs); on return AL(this addr)=ASCII, AH=scancode, then scancode normalization (0xE0/0x52 -> Enter 0x1C; 0x53 -> Esc 0x01; space sometimes -> Enter). INT 10h path: callers store AX=mode via *(uint16*)&this=0x13 or 3 then int386(0x10,...) to set/query video mode. Same scratch shared across input.c, dialog.c, save.c, menufld.c, aniend.c, chtrans.c, rsrc.c, main.c.
datatype: union REGS (Watcom <i86.h>, 28 bytes); this address aliases byte 0 = h.al (uint8). Ghidra currently types it as undefined[1].
element_semantics: Byte 0 / AL = ASCII code returned by INT 16h read-key (also low byte of AX for INT 10h mode-set). Byte 1 (0x53A8E) / AH = scancode on INT 16h return and INT 16h function-number preset (0x10). Remaining bytes are the rest of the union REGS register image used by other int386 calls.
notes: Ghidra had no plate/PRE/EOL at 0x53A8D (blank); created a PLATE_COMMENT (via run_script_inline + cu.setComment(PLATE_COMMENT,...)) reflecting the src conclusion (shared INT10h/16h union REGS scratch + two byte aliases). src comment is already accurate and complete in both main.c:1113-1121 (definition data_fd2_input_int16_regs) and globals.h:539-551 (macro aliases) -> comment_verdict=keep, main.c NOT edited (zero clobber risk). FD2.LE saved after plate creation. The src-side definition symbol is data_fd2_input_int16_regs; data_fd2_input_last_key_pressed exists in src only as a globals.h macro (.h.al), so Stage-2 rename of the Ghidra label aligns it with the emitted symbol.
